utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — Saturday 10 to 2 at your garage on Maple works, and I’ll just need to make sure the repair times are confirmed before I send anyone over.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — I’ll send it over in a bit. Really appreciate you coming by with the tool kit.

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — should I keep an eye out for faucet parts, or do you need anything else dropped off too?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the drop-off time and place before I treat it as final. What’s already confirmed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up, but I’ve heard the tools and volunteer list are being gathered, and Cleo has a quick tally of what we’re short on. The drop-off spot and time still sound unconfirmed, so I’d wait for that notice.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — I’ll hold off until the drop-off time and place are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m just checking what still needs fixing for the repair drive, so I can help fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes — we’re still on for the repair drive; can you confirm the time and drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s Saturday from 10 to 2, and the drop-off spot is Quinn’s garage on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, we’re still on for the repair drive, and I’ll bring the hammer by. Tell me what Vik wants tackled first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word to a few neighbors and see who can pitch in first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks — I’ll line up the tools and wait to hear who can come first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — once Rosa confirms the drop-off spot, I’ll line everything up around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks — once Rosa confirms it, I’ll fit it around pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll head over early and keep an eye out for the useful bits. Thanks for the update, Tess.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Anytime, Sam — I’ll let you know if anything new comes in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I’ve got the repair drive details lined up for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep everyone posted if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll keep an eye out for anything else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send out any updates if we still need anything else for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up, but it sounds like screws, brackets, and sturdy tape are the main gaps so far. I’ll check who’s organizing the first repair and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Nell — that helps a lot. If you can find who’s organizing the first repair, I’ll keep the tools and supplies lined up for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll check the notice and see who’s handling the first repair, then I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I know the drive is on, but I’m still waiting on the drop-off time and place before I treat it as final. Could you send the confirmed details when you have them?

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive to neighbors and pass along anyone who can help out.

utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, I’m still catching up on the repair drive—where should I drop off the tool kit?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still checking the time and address, but we’re on for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — just send me the time and address when you have them, and I’ll bring the tool kit.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Ira — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep the list updated if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks Rosa — I’ll pass that along while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot, and I’ll keep everyone posted if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s still moving along nicely—if you’re planning to stop by, I’d go early before the good stuff’s picked over. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — I’ll try to come early, and I’ll keep an eye on the school pickup times so it doesn’t clash.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s a good call—school pickup comes first. I’ll send along any updates, and hopefully you can swing by early enough to catch the better picks.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — do you still need any tools, or is the time the main thing now?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The time is the main thing now — once I pin that down, I can send you the address and drop-off details too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect — when you have the time pinned down, send me the address and drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming — what time and drop-off spot should I use for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still waiting on the exact time and spot, Kira — once Quinn confirms, I’ll stick to that plan.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll wait for Quinn’s confirmation, then. Please send the time and drop-off spot as soon as you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia — I’ve got the drop-off details now: Saturday from 10 to 2 at Quinn’s garage on Maple. If you want, I can help pass the word along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — that covers the main logistics. I’ll pass it along, and if anything shifts, please let me know so we can keep the timing clear.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — the repair drive is Saturday from 10 to 2, and you can drop the tool kit off at my garage on Maple anytime today. I’ll send the full details right away!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll swing by your garage on Maple today and drop off the tool kit. Thanks, Quinn; I’ll keep spreading the word and checking who can help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, thanks, Dane — I really appreciate you spreading the word. If anyone else can help, send them my way and I’ll keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — the hammer helps a lot. I’m still checking for the drill and screwdrivers, and if those show up, we can tackle the first fix.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll keep an eye out for the drill and screwdrivers, and I’ll bring the hammer by so we can get started.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll keep the tally updated and let you know as soon as the drill or screwdrivers turn up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m still a bit fuzzy, but I can check the notice again and help with the boxes if that’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren. Please check the notice and send me the exact time and drop-off spot when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll check the notice and send you the exact time and drop-off spot as soon as I can.
